newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan tea prices firm at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan tea prices firm at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were firm at the weekly tea auction with demand remaining strong, auction officials said on Monday.

Brighter, medium and lower medium BP1s advanced by between eight and 12 U.S. cents while Brighter PF1s were dearer by up to eight cents. Lighter descriptions gained up to 25 cents. Brightest PDUSTs were irregularly dearer, as were brighter DUST1s, while mediums gained up to ten cents.
In the secondary catalogues all descriptions were dearer with BMFs appreciating by over 15 cents.
